Name: Scarecrow and Rarecrow Recolors (to match Eemies Darker wood and gold craftables)
Author: Sithurism
Description:
[font=Arial][b][u][size=5]About[/size]
[/u][/b]
I really fell in love with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/419]Eemie's Medival Modern Buildings[/url] and combining it with her [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/687]Darker Wood and Gold Craftables[/url] so I decided to also make all my scarecrows match the theme and I thought I'd share.

[b][u][size=5]Contains[/size][/u][/b]

- Recolors/Modifications to
﻿- Scarecrow
﻿- Rarecrow #1
﻿﻿- Rarecrow #2
﻿﻿- Rarecrow #3
﻿﻿- Rarecrow #4
﻿﻿- Rarecrow #5
﻿﻿- Rarecrow #6
﻿﻿- Rarecrow #7
﻿﻿- Rarecrow #8

[b][u][size=5]How to Install
[/size][/u][/b][i][size=1]Users must have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] installed.[/size][/i]

[/font][list=1]
[*][font=Arial]Download the .zip file by clicking the 'Download' button on the download page of this mod.[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Extract the '[CP] New Scarecrows' folder to [code]﻿'Stardew Valley/Mods'[/code][/font]
[*][font=Arial]Run Stardew Valley using SMAPI (make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ installed) and enjoy the new scarecrows.[/font]
[/list][font=Arial]
[b][u][size=5]Updates/Changes[/size][/u][/b]

- [03/22/19] Added a Content Patcher version.
- [03/27/19] Fixed an issue regarding the Content Patcher version that resulted in an error message in SMAPI and stopped the pack from working.
- [03/27/19] Removed the XNB version from downloadable files.
- [03/27/19] Created a new Content Patcher version.

[/font][font=Arial][b][u][size=5]Other[/size][/u][/b]

This should be compatible with any other mods that edit Craftables.xnb so long as they aren't changing the same pixels as the scarecrows. If for some reason it isn't working in your game, check for other mods that edit or replace Craftables.xnb.

I also recommend getting [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1554]Allayna's Recolors to Match Eemiestardew's Color Pallet[/url] for more items to match the dark wood and golden theme.

[b][u][size=5]Credit[/size][/u][/b]

- Inspiration from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34984615]Eemiestardew[/url]﻿.[/font]
